claim: In JNext 1.1.104, DMA with both ports left at the reset timing is much slower than with cycle length 2 programmed (12.5 T against 3.6 T a byte), so program the timing.

evidence.text: JNext 1.1.104: both ports at cycle length 2 took 3.6 T a byte against 12.5 with the reset timing.

limit: JNext only. A KS1 (core 3.03.00, nxsuite D02) takes 6 T a byte with the reset timing and 4 T with cycle length 2 at 3.5 MHz (5.92 / 4.96 clocks at 28 MHz): there the timing byte saves a third, not two thirds.
